title: Civil Rights Act of 1968, Title VIII — Fair Housing Act — Original Enactment
trigger_event: Assassination of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., April 4, 1968
trigger_commission: National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission), Report February 29, 1968
legislative_precursor_blocked: Civil Rights Act of 1966 and 1967 — both failed in Senate through filibuster
companion_case: Jones v. Alfred H. Mayer Co., 392 U.S. 409 (1968) — decided June 17, 1968, two months after enactment; 42 U.S.C. § 1982 bars all racial property discrimination under Thirteenth Amendment enforcement power
federal_complicity_sources: FHA Underwriting Manual 1938 — racial stability provisions
HOLC residential security maps — redlining origin
VA loan guarantee program under GI Bill, Pub. L. 78-346 (1944) — exclusion of Black veterans
verified_note: Legislative history from training knowledge. Kerner Commission, Pub. L. 90-284 text, and Jones v. Mayer citation are verifiable. FHA/HOLC/VA primary sources available in National Archives.
